concerns.text: T006 replaces FR-002's mandated 'target-permutation, RMSE change as statistic' Full-vs-Null test with a paired fold-level sign-flip test. The correction may be statistically sound, but the spec was never amended, so the task now contradicts the FR it claims to satisfy ([FR-002] coverage map). Update spec.md FR-002/SC-002 wording to match, or the task silently rewrites a requirement.

A paired sign-flip permutation test over 5 GroupKFold folds has a minimum achievable two-sided p-value of 2/2^5 = 0.0625, making SC-002's α ≤ 0.05 threshold mathematically unreachable under T006's design. The task as written cannot satisfy the acceptance criterion it is mapped to; either increase paired units (more folds/repeats) or change the test.

FR-004 requires SHAP Interaction Values (2-D matrix) without qualification; T007 restricts computation to 'top-10 interaction features by absolute SHAP magnitude'. This narrowing is not staged in the spec, so the task weakens the FR. Record the CPU-budget restriction in spec.md FR-004 or compute the full matrix.

T003 states 'No residualization — interaction columns enter the model as plain products', dropping plan.md Phase 1's mandated orthogonalization of interaction columns against main effects. The plan was never updated; the task silently discards a plan constraint. Either amend plan.md with justification or restore the step.

plan.md Phase 2 mandates stratified-GroupKFold balancing composition one-hot categories across folds to mitigate residual confounding (also asserted in the plan's Constitution Check VII). No task implements this stratification; T004/T005 use plain GroupKFold. The plan's confounding mitigation is silently dropped.

FR-005 requires 'a large number of permutations' for empirical feature-importance p-values; T006 fixes 200 shuffles per column with no recorded justification (min achievable p = 1/200, limiting BH resolution). Document why 200 satisfies the FR or raise the count.

T013 pins `openml==0.14.*` and omits `datasets==2.19.*`, while plan.md's dependency list has `datasets` and no `openml`. The plan's dependency set no longer matches what tasks install; update plan.md to keep the reproducibility contract (Constitution I) coherent.
